verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents pre-recorded transcription via POST /v1/listen, but no item says the request can take a public or signed URL that Deepgram fetches itself. The callback feature [deepgram-docs-11] concerns where results are delivered, not how audio is ingested, so it earns no credit. This is a fair axis for a speech-to-text API, so the verdict is "none" rather than "na".

support.subject: As a developer, I can pass a public or signed URL and the service fetches and transcribes the recording without my uploading it
